people.name: Mara Vell
people.known_for: Captain of the early mixed-manufacturer freighter Common Cause; advocated practical cross-species component certification during the Standards Period.
people.legacy: A maintenance scholarship at New Houston bears her name.

people.name: Darak Venn
people.known_for: Led the Iron Gate team responsible for the first commercially successful very-heavy orbital keel assembled outside Keshar.
people.legacy: Venn inspection marks remain a colloquial name for several heavy-frame survey points.

people.name: Seli Ar
people.known_for: Developed drive-mount standards that allowed Ilyan propulsion packages to be installed reliably on heavier foreign hulls.
people.legacy: Often credited with making the modern mixed-origin freighter economically routine.

people.name: Sava Kel
people.known_for: Directed closed-cycle habitat work during Pelagos's early joint settlement.
people.legacy: Pelagos environmental certification awards carry Kel's name.

people.name: Ruun of Keshet
people.known_for: Designed early Port Meridian maintenance corridors around expansion access rather than finished station geometry.
people.legacy: Several supposedly temporary Ruun routes remain critical station service arteries two centuries later.

people.name: Jo Tanner
people.known_for: Operator of the aging R-61 Paid For, a familiar ship on the Meridian-Waystation-Lastlight run.
people.legacy: Not famous beyond the frontier; included as the sort of recurring working professional players should encounter.

people.name: Tekk of Var Junction
people.known_for: Senior tug operator for Meridian Recovery & Salvage.
people.legacy: Known among captains for charging exactly what the contract says and refusing to pretend a dangerous recovery is safe.

people.name: Nae Vesh
people.known_for: Principal navigator on several Lantern and Cairn surveys.
people.legacy: Current public charts contain numerous route annotations attributed to Vesh's crews.
